PDF chunk was cleaner overall: mean token F1 versus VietOCR 0.9423 vs 0.9043, lower suspicious ASCII-token ratio 0.0447 vs 0.0629, and 5 clear page wins versus 2 for per-image. It should be the main Markdown/layout draft source, while per-image MinerU and PaddleOCR+VietOCR remain verification and spelling-correction sources.
